question: Should OpenClaw publish an OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway access, and should its scope be limited to approved HTTP routes or include a broader Gateway protocol discovery story?
rationale: The implementation gap is clear, but accepting the request defines a new supported API discovery surface across security-sensitive Gateway HTTP routes and existing TypeBox protocol schemas.

options.title: Approve scoped HTTP OpenAPI
options.body: Generate a versioned OpenAPI document for approved Gateway HTTP routes, document bearer/operator auth semantics, and keep WebSocket RPC on TypeBox/JSON Schema.

options.title: Defer to Gateway RPC docs
options.body: Keep Gateway protocol docs, RPC reference, and TypeBox/JSON Schema as the supported programmatic path until maintainers want an HTTP OpenAPI contract.

options.title: Serve runtime Swagger later
options.body: Expose a runtime /openapi.json or Swagger UI only after approving route inclusion, auth requirements, and private-ingress behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped HTTP OpenAPI
recommendation.body: Generate a versioned OpenAPI document for approved Gateway HTTP routes, document bearer/operator auth semantics, and keep WebSocket RPC on TypeBox/JSON Schema.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest inspected history on Gateway HTTP routing plus the prior config OpenAPI proposal.
